propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 rejects all verification indices as unexpected when Pass-1 produces zero findings, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite emitting PASS verdict

The root cause is an index-basis mismatch where verify_instructions() returns an imperative to emit verifications for an empty finding batch, and the model returns indices 0..N-1 against an empty sent domain
All 43 affected runs had zero LLM findings in Pass-1 and correct PASS verdicts; no findings were lost and no reviews need revisiting
INDETERMINATE findings cannot block because pass3_decide(None) short-circuits before the blocking_enabled test, and orchestrator only blocks on non-empty blocking bucket
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches instead of an impossible imperative, preventing spurious contract violations
